props.layerName: How do I move or hide Toadal?
props.text: How do I move or hide Toadal?

props.layerName: Tap Toadal to open or minimize his tip. Drag him to move; double-tap to hide him. You can also choose Hide Toadal in his tip or navigation menu, then use Show Toadal in the menu or footer to bring him back.
props.text: Tap Toadal to open or minimize his tip. Drag him to move; double-tap to hide him. You can also choose Hide Toadal in his tip or navigation menu, then use Show Toadal in the menu or footer to bring him back.

props.layerName: With a keyboard, use the navigation menu's Show/Hide Toadal control or focus Toadal and press Enter or Space to open his tip. Arrow keys move him; Tab reaches his Hide control. Your saved choice stays in this browser when storage is available.
